scientific_integrity: Analytical birth-death proof and saddlepoint asymptotic, plus reproducible exact-rational finite checks; the general stochastic mechanism and qualitative q-voter phase are pre-existing. An unlocated equivalent finite-state result remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Neutral two-type process with quadratic threshold, independent with-replacement encounter sampling including possible focal self-contact, and fixed encounter count in the large-population asymptotic; no payoff selection, network exclusion, fixation time result, or independent priority certification.
title: Exact sample-size suppression in finite neutral complex contagion
